subject.title: Feature: Opt-in cross-channel visibility in TUI (mirror iMessage/Telegram activity)

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in TUI observe/mirror mode that can display activity across channel and session boundaries, and what transcript scope and authorization rules should constrain it?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested behavior changes sensitive transcript visibility and likely adds public CLI/config surface, which requires maintainer intent rather than an automated fix choice.

options.title: Design scoped read-only observe mode
options.body: Add a default-off observer only after maintainers define session scope, channel inclusion, authorization, audit behavior, and redaction expectations.

options.title: Limit this to selected-session live-tail
options.body: Let the linked TUI session.message PR handle same-session live updates and keep cross-channel observation out of scope for now.

options.title: Decline broad TUI observation
options.body: Document openclaw logs --follow and explicit --session attachment as the supported monitoring paths for cross-surface activity.

recommendation.title: Design scoped read-only observe mode
recommendation.body: Add a default-off observer only after maintainers define session scope, channel inclusion, authorization, audit behavior, and redaction expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on the TUI session isolation behavior and current TUI event surface.
